description: This file defines the SQLCachedCollection class, which implements a cached wrapper around a SQLCollection for managing database records with in-memory caching, supporting operations like init, clear, upsert, delete, softDelete, exists, get, put, update, and iteration over unsynced and active items.

classes.name: SQLCachedCollection
classes.description: A class implementing a cached database collection with in-memory Map for efficient record management, supporting CRUD operations, soft delete, and iteration over unsynced and active items.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SQLCachedCollection with dependencies like database accessor, transaction starter, collection type, event manager, and sanitizer.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the underlying SQLCollection and populates the in-memory cache with existing records.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cache and underlying collection data.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates an item in the collection and cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes items by IDs from cache and collection.

methods.name: softDelete
methods.description: Marks items as deleted without removing them from the collection, updating cache accordingly.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in cache and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item by ID if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds or updates multiple items in the collection and cache.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates multiple items partially and reflects changes in cache.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Returns a record of items by IDs from cache.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns an array of items, optionally filtered by IDs, excluding deleted items.

methods.name: unsynced
methods.description: Generator yielding chunks of unsynced items for synchronization.

methods.name: unsyncedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unsynced items.
